Prerequisite(s): Augment Summoning feat

Benefit: When casting any Summon Monster spell, the summoner can choose to change one ability score to receive the bonus granted by Augment Summoning to another ability score (STR/CON can change into DEX/CON). This choice applies to all creatures summoned by the spell. A summoner with the augment avatar summon talent may apply the effects of this summon talent to his avatar upon performing the summoning ritual. Choosing this talent again allows the summoner to change both bonuses.
